With more than 20 years’ experience, BrookBirch Landscapes is a leading Liverpool based landscaping firm, which operates across Merseyside and throughout the North West.

As artificial turf and paving specialists, professional services for both domestic and commercial customers include artificial grass, driveways, patios, decking, fencing and brickwork, all of which can be tailored to your specific needs, requirements and budget.

Are you looking to transform your back garden into a tranquil retreat or a safe play space for your children? Are you the BBQ king or queen wanting a place to entertain during house parties? Do you want to make a great first impression of your home with a welcoming driveway? Do you want to breathe a new lease of life into your office by bringing the outdoors inside for a contemporary workspace? Is your organisation, venue, events space or beer garden in need of a total landscape overhaul?
Contact us for a free quotation.

Communication is key when delivering a professional and personable service, which is why the team at BrookBirch Landscapes pride ourselves on our genuine approach and work closely beside our customers to combine your vision with our creative expertise.

As part of the bespoke services available at BrookBirch Landscapes, we listen carefully to your ideas and expectations to deliver a quality result tailored to you. In line with our efforts to provide cutting edge excellence, our attention to detail and unique landscaping designs will transform your garden into an outdoor living space that not only looks great, but will add value to your property.

To ensure peace of mind and quality assurance, the services provided by BrookBirch Landscapes come with a five-year workmanship guarantee. Likewise, all of the artificial grass that used is European manufactured and comes with a 10-15 year UV warranty.

We provide exceptional landscaping services to a wide range of commercial and residential properties for over 35 years. Our experienced landscapers set the standard each day in landscape design, paving, hardscaping. We will get your garden in best design and shape in no time.
